scope: Static implementation-bound review; full execution and publication remain separate.

boundaries.name: raster_targets_and_preparation
boundaries.contract: Decoded RGB uint8 rasters and aligned binary masks feed unshifted and half-shifted tiles, mask-area ordering, JPEG roundtrip, standard-deviation filtering and rounded-area presence bins.
boundaries.limitation: Binary foreground semantics, physical scale, color statistics and lossy preprocessing must be justified for each application. A nonempty mask can enter the background sampling population. TIFF decoding and stain normalization are not implemented by this graph.

boundaries.name: population_independence
boundaries.contract: Caller-supplied group labels partition whole rasters before tile preparation. Both training and validation must retain selected tiles. Pseudo populations append to training only.
boundaries.limitation: Group labels do not establish independence of subjects, acquisition sessions or sources. The caller must exclude validation overlap from pseudo sources; the implementation does not detect that overlap.

boundaries.name: fresh_training_and_checkpoint_selection
boundaries.contract: Each FoldStage constructs a full SE-ResNeXt101 segmentation model from explicit encoder state with fresh decoder, Adam optimizer and cosine scheduler. Ordered selectors identify produced fold/checkpoint roles; retraining starts fresh and consumes generated pseudo masks.
boundaries.limitation: Encoder-state shape compatibility and deterministic seeds do not authenticate pretrained weights or prove accuracy. Explicit stage schedules and checkpoint roles must be executable. The graph stage functions use _train_stages directly and do not inherit all run_lifecycle selector validation.

boundaries.name: pseudo_label_policy
boundaries.contract: Initial models generate masks with four flip views and threshold0.5. Ordered pseudo populations retain only rounded-bin-positive tiles for retraining.
boundaries.limitation: Pseudo masks are model outputs, not independent ground truth. Positive-only filtering, area bins and augmentation invariance are recipe assumptions; application transfer requires justification and independent evaluation.

boundaries.name: inference_geometry_and_batch_dependence
boundaries.contract: Final inference uses three flip views, ordered model averaging, resize before strict thresholding and source grid stitching. The classifier shortcut skips the segmentation path when all examples in a batch fall below its classifier threshold.
boundaries.limitation: Batch composition, tile scale, padding, normalization and thresholds affect meaning and output. An empty final mask can result from the classifier shortcut; it is not evidence of absent foreground. Binary outputs are not calibrated uncertainty estimates.

boundaries.name: runtime_objects_and_reusable_units
boundaries.contract: Graph boundaries pass runtime arrays, FoldStage objects, explicit RNG streams, checkpoint bytes and evaluation models. Model restoration requires a nonempty ordered checkpoint ensemble; inference uses zero data-loader workers.
boundaries.limitation: These provider interfaces are recipe stages and trusted runtime-object boundaries, not a generic JSON service. Image tiling, balanced sampling and aggregation need independently qualified contracts before standalone cross-domain selection.

reuse_decision: The recipe may transfer to other binary raster-segmentation tasks with justified foreground semantics, physical scale, color and augmentation assumptions, independent grouped populations and pseudo-source isolation. Keep explicit stage and inference policies. Generic image or sampling operations require independent qualification before standalone selection.
remaining: Review original source stages and exact provider interfaces.
Qualify current full networks, source-sized geometry and complete fold routing with bounded resources.
Execute the corrected stored graph and verify transactional publication and selection.
